##### Project general facts

XL Tower is a commercial tower by DAMAC Properties, designed for companies that want a professional, well-serviced business address. The building combines office floors with retail space, served by high-speed elevators and generous lobbies on every level.

Occupiers and their staff have access to a swimming pool, a gym, an aerobics room and a health club, so a workout or a swim fits easily into the working day. A cafeteria inside the tower covers daily meals and informal meetings without leaving the building.

The interiors are planned as practical commercial space, leaving each occupier free to arrange the layout around its own team, clients and brand.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a central Dubai business district built along the Dubai Water Canal, next to Downtown Dubai and Sheikh Zayed Road. Its towers house corporate offices, hotels and residences, with waterfront promenades running beside the canal.

Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa are a short drive away, and City Walk and DIFC are close by. Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road link the district to Dubai Media City, Mall of the Emirates and Dubai International Airport, while Business Bay Metro station serves daily commutes.

Business Bay is one of the city's most established addresses for office and retail tenants, which keeps leasing demand steady across the district. Commercial property here is freehold for international buyers, and the mix of corporate, hospitality and residential towers gives investors a broad tenant base.
